main_text.head: Alia Hirundinis imago, quam ex Italia accepi, piscis volantis specie: pinnis nempe in transversum extensis, eadem demissae natantis speciem praebebunt.

page.notes: The page is dominated by a woodcut of a flying fish (illustration, not text), described here only: a fish with wing-like pectoral fins spread sideways, and a forked tail. The caption is printed in italic in two lines and is transcribed above as a head. The "D" at lower right is a gathering signature mark.
